rules.rule: Use the mastery time-box title on a core money skill (marketing, sales, ads): 'N Years of X Advice in N Mins', 'Learn 97% of X in N Minutes', 'Give Me N Minutes and I'll Make You Disgustingly Good at X'. Keep it off self-help topics.
rules.evidence: All 10 long-form mastery time-box titles in all.tsv: median outlier 3.39. The 8 on marketing/sales/ads: median 4.15, lowest 1.71 (hASHO5ap1Sw 15.53, Jun 21 2024; NTmWqnPIb2s 11.82, Jun 12 2026; HsjuAvqs3zU 8.6; rsgvkkpNg7Y 4.68; QN_LVgvik-k 3.62; 7xtRHa7b96w 3.16; bFR1y5_kAB4 1.91; oEVLJsgQg0s 1.71). The 2 on self-help: k9vfmiklBDc 'Give me 23 minutes, and I'll improve your communication skills by 87%' 0.66 and d-TCqFl0b5k 'Give me 18 Minutes and I'll Make you Dangerously Confident' 0.53. hASHO5ap1Sw beat a 103,000-view neighbour median, so era cannot explain it.

rules.rule: The 'How [Iconic Brand] Brainwashes You to Buy [$price item]' exposé was his biggest engine in 2024 to 2025 but has faded. A remake of the biggest hit did not repeat it, so treat the series as saturated rather than as a template.
rules.evidence: 4 of the top 6 by views: TDmbwAeBOwU 3.9M, 35.45 (Aug 9 2024); ZCw6BhJVe3k 1.1M, 11.06 (May 23 2025); WKbh5AQoqaE 807K, 7.02 (May 10 2025); SBkY-hQyY2U 474K, 4.37 (Dec 28 2024). The 7 'How X Brainwash(es) You' titles at all.tsv index 75 to 99 have a median of 5.35; the 5 at index 1 to 68 have a median of 1.15. KvzazRPcwVY (index 1, Oct 10 2026) reuses the title 'How Luxury Brands Brainwash You To Buy' and an almost identical thumbnail (the trick, hush pose, LV queue) and sits at 0.65.

rules.rule: For an exposé, stage his face in the 'secret' pose (finger to lips) in front of the brand's own storefront, with 0 to 3 words. The scene does the work, not the text.
rules.evidence: All 4 brainwash hits use it: TDmbwAeBOwU ('The trick', 2 words), SBkY-hQyY2U ('The trick', 2), ZCw6BhJVe3k (no added words), WKbh5AQoqaE ('MADE IN CHINA' tag, 3). Median outlier of the four 9.04. But the same layout on KvzazRPcwVY got 0.65, and the earlier teardown measured scene-composite at median 0.62 (n=3) in the latest 30, so it only works when the topic is fresh.

rules.rule: On modern thumbnails, keep the headline to 5 words or fewer and make it add something the title lacks: a command, a price, a verdict or a proof number.
rules.evidence: All 8 organic top-view thumbnails (2023 to 2026, median outlier 11.44) have a headline of 0 to 5 words, and every headline complements the title: 'The trick' (TDmbwAeBOwU, SBkY-hQyY2U), 'DON'T ASK. MAKE THEM BUY.' (hASHO5ap1Sw), 'DON'T RUN VIDEO ADS' + '$300M in ad spend' (NTmWqnPIb2s), '$100 MILLION' (J2ASNvEyfTs 14.09), '$4,225?' (IBjTr6ILJF0 3.71). The 2019 to 2021 breakouts used 4 to 10 words that mostly repeat the title, but their ratios are inflated (see the era rule).

rules.rule: Put a money figure in the package, either a price in the title or a single dollar figure on the thumbnail.
rules.evidence: Price in title: ZCw6BhJVe3k '$80,000 Watches' 11.06, WKbh5AQoqaE '$70,000 Handbags' 7.02. Dollar figure as the thumbnail's only word: J2ASNvEyfTs '$100 MILLION' 14.09, IBjTr6ILJF0 '$4,225?' 3.71. Proof label: NTmWqnPIb2s '$300M in ad spend' 11.82. Counter-evidence: 6T0UTS8GrSE 'How Disney Brainwashes You To Spend $950k' 1.15, and the earlier teardown found numbers in titles did not separate hits from misses (median 0.75 with vs 1.06 without).

rules.rule: Do not copy the 2019 to 2021 breakout formula (long keyword how-to, 🔥 emojis, 'Step-By-Step' and a hype parenthetical such as '(Extremely Potent)' or '(Crazy)'). Its huge ratios come from tiny neighbours, and the same formula underperforms today.
rules.evidence: All 10 top breakouts were published May 2019 to Oct 2021, with neighbour medians of only 3,300 to 9,600 views; several windows hold 3 or 4 sub-3-minute testimonial clips. Yc8Ulva-imw is 84.55 on 279K views against a median of 3,300. Z_H08RpYKgg sits at index 472 of 473, so its window has 11 neighbours, not 20. Recent 'Step-By-Step' titles score 0.77 (GLB4XrLGX5A), 0.56 (9Z28xv4YVmw) and 0.91 (yr5DnEE2kyI). Title length: breakouts median 82 characters vs 46.5 for the top-view list.

rules.rule: Exclude the paid book ads from any packaging lesson. Two of the top 10 by views are Sell Like Crazy ads, not organic uploads.
rules.evidence: mOQbtHp3WBU is titled 'Algorithm’s Secret Sauce | Sell Like Crazy Ad' (256s, 431K views, like rate 0.28%). JF4rjHOZbLo 'Sell Like Crazy: Stop Praying To The Internet Gods' (281s, 642K views, 0.37%) has a description that is a sales letter for the book with one go.kingkong.co link. The 8 organic top-view videos have like rates of 1.86% to 4.65%. Neither thumbnail has text, and neither shows Sabri's face from the front.

rules.rule: The description did not make the hits. Keep it short, with a proof plus promise first line; chapters and hashtags are optional.
rules.evidence: Chapters appear on 1 of 20 (Yc8Ulva-imw, 5 chapters from 0:00). Real hashtags range from 0 to 12: 8 to 12 on 3 of the 4 brainwash hits and 0 on hASHO5ap1Sw (15.53), NTmWqnPIb2s (11.82) and J2ASNvEyfTs (14.09). Lengths run from 296 to 1,329 characters on the organic top views. The 2023 to 2025 proof line 'I've worked with thousands of clients, generating them over $7.8 Billion in sales' opens hASHO5ap1Sw, SBkY-hQyY2U and IBjTr6ILJF0. The 2019 to 2021 breakouts opened with the same 'FREE Training' lead-magnet ad on 7 of 10.
